dedupe_keys.name: k willebrand flexible ops plan design data and code for valuing combinations of flexible planning design and operations in water supply infrastructure

description: The water-supply research team publishes MATLAB code for jointly evaluating planning, design and operating flexibility. Zenodo archives version 1.0 under CC BY 4.0 and links a public repository. The README describes climate-state transitions, precipitation and inflow generation, reservoir-operation stochastic dynamic programming, and an infrastructure-expansion programme. Mwache Dam in Kenya supplies the case study. Outputs include operating policies, expected shortages, investment actions and costs under climate uncertainty. The model can test when adaptive dam capacity or operating rules reduce water-service risk. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this three-level implementation. Coverage is its Mwache assumptions and generated long climate paths, not a validated prediction of future inflows. A limitation is that large data files are distributed through a separate GitHub release and MATLAB is required. The archived code was not run, and expected cost or reliability gains were not reproduced.
